question: Hemant Chauhan, who received the Padma Shri in 2023, is associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarati music**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemant Chauhan** received the **Padma Shri** in 2023 for his contributions to **Gujarati music**.
 
• He is a well-known figure in the field of **Gujarati devotional and folk music**.
 
• Hemant Chauhan has significantly contributed to the preservation and popularization of traditional **Gujarati music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their distinguished contributions in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Receiving the Padma Shri is a significant honor, recognizing an individual's exceptional service to the nation.
